name: populate-quick-plot-stack
description: One-time layer-population workflow: pip-install the scientific Python stack into the quick-plot-stack EFS layer. Triggered manually by admin via POST /runs. Re-run to update the layer's contents (subject to workflow-service's layer-versioning model — see open questions in plan doc).

defaultParams.requirements:
matplotlib
seaborn
pandas
numpy
scipy
flowkit
fcsparser
anndata
scanpy
nibabel
tifffile
pillow
pyreadr
pyarrow
h5py
